stories.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
stories.explanation: The US ordered federal agencies to remove China's DeepSeek AI products and services from their systems due to national security concerns regarding data access by Chinese authorities. This move highlights intensifying tech competition and concerns over sensitive government information.

stories.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
stories.explanation: Eka Robotics, founded by MIT and Google DeepMind researchers, closed a $150 million Series A round, valuing it at $1.45 billion, for its physical AI model that excels at dexterous object manipulation. Experts praise its superhuman performance in certain tasks, signaling a breakthrough in robotics.

stories.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
stories.explanation: OpenAI is advancing ChatGPT's capabilities in low-resource programming languages like COBOL and Fortran, which are critical for essential services. This improvement aims to help developers maintain and modernize software in these languages, addressing a key challenge for enterprises.

stories.title: A visit to Samsung’s massive new semiconductor hub
stories.explanation: Samsung is expanding its semiconductor manufacturing complex in Pyeongtaek, South Korea, to meet the growing demand for specialized memory chips used in AI models. This signifies major infrastructure investment driven by the AI boom.

stories.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
stories.explanation: Character.AI declared bankruptcy as part of a deal allowing Disney to hire most of its staff and potentially acquire its technology, while avoiding the startup's legal liabilities related to chatbot safety. This strategic move highlights the legal challenges faced by AI companies and how larger entities might acquire their assets.

stories.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
stories.explanation: Anthropic's Claude model successfully designed protein minibinders against scorpion neurotoxins, with 17 out of 211 designs experimentally confirmed to bind. This demonstrates Claude's potential to accelerate drug discovery and enable non-experts in biomedical research.

stories.title: GenRecs Tokenization: Transforming Ads Recommendation at Meta with Stable Model Vocabulary
stories.explanation: Meta introduced GenRecs Tokenization, a new data representation for its ads recommendation systems that uses LLM architecture to reason about ad content and user preferences. This allows the system to predict more relevant ads, even for new products without prior engagement history.

stories.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
stories.explanation: Spotify removed over 50 million AI-generated or spam tracks from its music recommendations and updated its system to highlight human artists. This action addresses the issue of low-quality AI content impacting user experience and promotes human creativity.

stories.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
stories.explanation: Meta is suspending the sharing feature of its AI agent, Muse, after researchers reported it could expose sensitive information through easily discoverable Web links. This highlights privacy concerns with AI agents and Meta's response to address them.

stories.title: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
stories.explanation: A former OpenAI engineer, Abdulrahman Alfozan, was denied release by a court after being accused of spying on OpenAI and having ties to the Saudi government. This highlights security concerns within leading AI labs and potential state-sponsored interest in AI technology.
